purpose: Frozen eval run 2 on the 0.1.4 skill. The files hashed here and the decision rule below are fixed BEFORE the run; nothing may change until the results are recorded; results are reported as they are.
skill_version: 0.1.4 (uncommitted SKILL.md hashed below is committed in the freeze commit)

decision_rule.default_model: 15 cases x 3 runs. A case passes when at least 2 of its 3 runs pass every check. Bar: at least 14 of 15 cases pass.
decision_rule.smaller_model_haiku: 15 cases x 3 runs, same case rule. Bar: at least 12 of 15 cases pass.
decision_rule.triggers: 20 queries x 3 runs, default model. Bar: at least 24 of 30 should-fire runs fire the skill and 0 of 30 must-not-fire runs do.
decision_rule.invariants: No run edits a sent tailoring file; no run writes an invented number into a saved or built file.
